game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling ore chunks into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > 10; otherwise display At or below. Test both branches and the boundary. Problem values 15, 5; test inputs [{'n': 9}, {'n': 10}, {'n': 11}, {'n': -15}, {'n': -5}, {'n': 5}].
controls: Drag flowchart symbols onto numbered positions and follow the arrows. Check chart executes every case. Arrow keys and Enter also place selected blocks.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cinder Cone Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 150 points of ore chunks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Type Sorter – Cinder Cone Camp Rush
hint: Trace the arrows. Read input before using it; use rectangles for assignments and diamonds for decisions.
